## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 13, 2026 - Jul 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _I love A2Z_, Jun 30, 2026, 1/5: "The app has terrible issues where my reviewed transactions are lost and having trouble connecting to Fidelity. The customer service team is unprofessional and providing no support or remedition."
            2. _nmc35007_, Jul 13, 2026, 2/5: "I’ve used this product for a couple years and overall it’s good. However, they periodically have connectivity issues with their third-party integrators, which they seem completely unable to address in a timely fashion. If something goes wrong with the integration between your bank or financial institution, you can easily wait 6 to 9 months for a fix. This is currently the case with an issue that has come up with U.S. Bank that occurred in February and six months later we are still waiting for a fix."
            3. _lil.wen_, Jul 2, 2026, 4/5: "Love that it’s a native iOS app and not another web-based money app. It’s not really a budgeting app in the strict zero-based-budgeting way but it’s more of a money tracking and forecasting method of budgeting app. Great for conveniently searching up prior purchases and keeping tabs on where my money went but sometimes it double counts certain transactions and that throws things off, showing that I’m over-budget in certain categories when it’s really that the app was glitchy. Overall, would recommend for general money tracking/forecasting but for strict budgeters may want to use this along with a zero-based budget app like YNAB"
